description: This file defines the BIFFwriter class responsible for generating and writing BIFF (Binary Interchange and File Format) records in the context of Excel file creation using PHP. It includes methods for managing binary data streams, handling byte order, writing stream headers and footers, and managing record size limitations.

classes.name: BIFFwriter
classes.description: A class for handling the writing of BIFF format records for Excel spreadsheets, including management of data streams, record splitting, and stream headers.

methods.name: getByteOrder
methods.description: Determines the byte order (endianness) of the architecture and caches it for future use.

methods.name: append
methods.description: Appends binary data to the internal BIFF data stream, handling record size limitations.

methods.name: writeData
methods.description: Returns binary data, formatting with continuation records if needed, for writing to the BIFF stream.

methods.name: storeBof
methods.description: Writes the Beginning of File (BOF) record to indicate the start of an Excel stream or substream.

methods.name: storeEof
methods.description: Writes the End of File (EOF) record to conclude the BIFF stream.

methods.name: writeEof
methods.description: Returns the EOF record as a string for output, marking the end of the BIFF stream.

methods.name: addContinue
methods.description: Splits long BIFF records into continuation blocks to adhere to Excel's record size limits.
